card.name: Inside the word millicuries
card.fires_on: The piece "lic" in the middle of the misspelled unit "millicuries" (mCi), right after "mil" and following a megabecquerel (MBq) dose. Rarely, it fires on similar word pieces inside other odd or joined words.
